title: Edge counts of a graph and its complement
statement: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ with $n = \abs{V}$ vertices, and let $G^{c}$ denote its complement, the simple graph on $V$ in which two distinct vertices are adjacent precisely when they are not adjacent in $G$. Then the number of edges of $G$ together with the number of edges of $G^{c}$ equals the number of unordered pairs of vertices, \[ \abs{E(G)} + \abs{E(G^{c})} = \binom{n}{2}. \]
hypotheses_covered: finite vertex set V with n = card V
G a simple graph with complement Gᶜ
